title: BTS Preps for Debut El Paso Shows — City, UTEP, and ARMY Ready for May 2–3 ARIRANG World Tour
detail: May 1, 2026 is pre-concert day as BTS prepares for the ARIRANG World Tour's El Paso leg at Sun Bowl Stadium (UTEP campus), with shows scheduled for May 2–3 at 8:00 PM local time. Local El Paso broadcaster KVIA notes cooler weather is expected for the concert dates, with temperatures in the mid-60s and slight wind. The Sun Bowl — which seats approximately 51,500 — is sold out for both nights, representing BTS's first-ever performances in El Paso and in the US–Mexico border region. The concerts are expected to draw fans from across West Texas, New Mexico, and northern Mexico, with cross-border visitor estimates from Ciudad Juárez in the thousands. UTEP's Office of Special Events, which co-manages the Sun Bowl venue, has coordinated extensive transportation and crowd management logistics for the event. Local media coverage highlights the economic windfall for downtown El Paso businesses, with hotel occupancy in the metro area fully booked. The El Paso run closes the US continental leg before the ARIRANG World Tour moves to additional North American and international markets.

media.caption: El Paso prepares for BTS's debut shows at Sun Bowl Stadium on May 2–3, the first-ever BTS concerts in the US–Mexico border region

title: HYBE Posts Record Q1 2026 Revenue of $478M — BTS Comeback Drives 39.5% Year-Over-Year Growth
detail: HYBE Corporation releases its Q1 2026 financial results, reporting record revenue of 698.3 billion KRW (approximately $478 million USD), a 39.5% increase year-over-year. The growth is attributed primarily to BTS's reunited comeback: the album 'ARIRANG' (released March 20, 2026) achieved unprecedented first-day physical sales of 3.98 million copies on Hanteo and first-day Spotify streams of 110 million — both K-pop records. The ARIRANG World Tour's North American leg, now mid-run with Tampa concluded and El Paso upcoming, contributes additional concert merchandise and licensing revenue. The company notes a one-time charge of ₩255 billion related to Chairman Bang Si-hyuk's employee stock grant program, which resulted in an operating loss for the quarter despite strong operational performance. Analysts from NH Securities and Hanwha Investment upgrade HYBE stock following the results, citing the multi-year revenue arc of BTS's full reunion. The Q1 results represent a decisive validation of the HYBE-BTS model following the two-year military service hiatus.

media.caption: HYBE's record Q1 2026 revenue of $478M is driven by BTS's 'ARIRANG' comeback and the ongoing ARIRANG World Tour
